newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei 225 average falls below 21,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei 225 average falls below 21,000 level.

text.p: The key Nikkei 225 average fell below the 21,000 level in early Wednesday trade for the first time in over a week as investors were sidelined waiting for a new government and its policies to take shape, brokers said.
The benchmark fell momentarily after opening, falling as low as 20,943.50, but soon clawed back above the 21,000 line.
As of 0015 GMT, the Nikkei average was lower by 95.83 points or 0.45 percent at 21,027.85. Its December futures were down 80 points at 21,090.
Brokers said some investors were interested in buying on dips, despite the gloomy atmosphere, providing some support and further falls were likely to be shallow.
